results.criterion: a cacheable 200 (range-free GET) is stored and a repeat request is served from the store (X-Cache: HIT observability stamp)
the reused response body is byte-identical to the stored response
the reused response preserves the stored status code
the reused response preserves the stored header fields (ETag, Content-Type, Accept-Ranges)
Content-Length on the replayed response equals the replayed body size
is an error response (404) stored and reused? (permitted for 404 via heuristic freshness; recorded, not judged)
a response generated by the origin for this request does not carry Age (its presence implies cache replay)
when a stored response is used without validation the cache MUST generate an Age header field
Age is a non-negative delta-seconds integer
current_age grows with resident time: ~3s after storage the replayed Age is in [2..6]
an origin with a clock MUST generate Date; a downstream cache cannot compute apparent_age without it
a cache MUST NOT store any part of a request carrying Cache-Control: no-store, or of its response
a cache MUST NOT use a stored response to satisfy a request with Cache-Control: no-cache without successful validation on the origin
max-age=0: the client is unwilling to accept any stored response unless validated (equivalent to no-cache)
a stored response whose current_age exceeds the request max-age MUST NOT be used to satisfy it
min-fresh=3600: the client wants a response still fresh in 3600s; the deployed lifetime is 60s, so no stored response qualifies
only-if-cached: a cache that cannot satisfy the request from its store MUST respond 504 (Gateway Timeout), not contact the origin
only-if-cached on a stored-fresh entry: reply using the stored response (or 504); forwarding to the origin is the one forbidden path
Pragma: no-cache on a request without Cache-Control SHOULD be treated as Cache-Control: no-cache

does the origin advertise explicit freshness (Cache-Control/Expires) on the cacheable 200? absent means every downstream cache falls back to heuristics while this cache uses an internal 60s lifetime the response never names

response no-store/private/max-age/s-maxage/must-revalidate cannot be exercised from the wire: the origin emits no Cache-Control and the store applies a constant lifetime independent of response directives — the honoring path is untestable (and unimplemented)
results.observed: store lifetime is the proven constant; response directives are not consulted at store time

results.criterion: an origin that varies the representation on Accept-Encoding SHOULD send Vary: Accept-Encoding on the response

a stored response with a selecting header (content-coding chosen by Accept-Encoding) MUST NOT be reused for a request whose selecting header does not match: the cache key must incorporate the Vary dimension
results.observed: hit=True Content-Encoding=b'gzip' body-is-gzip=True (gzip variant served to a client that never offered gzip)

results.criterion: serving the stored identity variant to a gzip-capable client is permitted (identity is always acceptable); the body must not be mislabeled
If-None-Match matching the stored ETag is answered 304 from the cache path
a 304 response has no content
a 304 carries the header fields (ETag) that would have been sent in the 200
If-None-Match not matching is answered with the full 200
If-Match not matching the selected representation is answered 412
a HEAD response is not replayed for a GET (the GET body is full)
results.observed: GET after HEAD: status=200 body=35B hit=False

results.criterion: a POST response is not stored/replayed (POST is not cacheable here — no explicit freshness)
a cache MUST invalidate the target URI when it receives a non-error response to an unsafe method (POST)
results.observed: POST answered 200 (non-error) and the pre-POST entry was still replayed (hit=True, Age=b'0')

results.criterion: a ranged GET on a hot cache entry is answered 206 with the requested part, not the stored full 200
a cache MUST NOT reuse a stored partial (206) response to satisfy a request for the full representation
results.observed: plain GET after ranged: status=200 body=35B hit=False

results.criterion: a stored response is reused only for an identical target URI (distinct query strings are distinct entries)

a shared cache MUST NOT store the response to a request with an Authorization field unless the response explicitly allows it (public / must-revalidate / s-maxage) — this response carries no such directive
results.observed: unauthenticated follow-up hit=True (authorized response replayed to an unauthenticated client)

results.criterion: within the 60s lifetime the stored response is reusable and Age never exceeds the lifetime
a response past its freshness lifetime MUST NOT be served from the store without validation (no stale replay)
after expiry the next origin response is stored again (the cache recovers; follow-up is a fresh replay with small Age)
the Warning field is deprecated: a cache SHOULD NOT generate it
